meta.title: Our story
meta.description: Meet Adrian and Alondra, the parents behind Tiny Humans: newborn and baby photos at home, anywhere from Miami to Orlando.

hero.title: Hi, we're Adrian & Alondra
hero.intro: We're the husband-and-wife team behind Tiny Humans, and parents ourselves. We bring the studio to your home, so your little one can stay warm, fed and comfy while we capture these first weeks.

story.title: How Tiny Humans started
paragraphs: It started with our own newborn. We wanted those sleepy, curled-up first photos, but we didn't want to pack up a brand-new baby and drive across town to a studio. We looked for a photographer who would come to our home, and we couldn't find one.
Adrian had been behind the camera for about two years, photographing all kinds of things. Once our baby arrived, newborns and little ones became the moments we most wanted to capture.

meet.title: Meet Adrian & Alondra
paragraphs: Tiny Humans started with our own newborn. We wanted photos at home, and we couldn't find anyone who would come to us. So we became that photographer.
Home is where babies, and parents, are most comfortable: no car seat, no packing the whole nursery, and feeding whenever baby wants.
Adrian photographs and edits every session. Alondra designs the set-ups, styling and little details. We're parents too, and we know how fast these first weeks go.

items.q: Is it safe for a newborn?
items.a: Yes, safety always comes first. We keep the room warm, wash and sanitize our hands, and never use unsupported poses: any tricky pose is a safe composite of two photos. A parent stays within arm's reach, and we don't wear fragrance.

items.q: How soon after birth should we book?
items.a: Any time that suits you. The first couple of weeks are lovely for sleepy, curled-up newborn photos, and we photograph little ones up to 2 years old. Expecting? Book with your due date and we'll adjust the day once baby arrives.

items.q: What if baby comes early or late, or is fussy or hungry?
items.a: Every session goes at baby's pace, with feeding and cuddle breaks built in. You can move or cancel your session online up to {notice} before, or just text us. And if baby can't settle, we'll come back once, free, within 14 days.
items.aDeposit: Every session goes at baby's pace, with feeding and cuddle breaks built in. You can move or cancel your session online up to {notice} before (cancel and we refund your deposit), or just text us. And if baby can't settle, we'll come back once, free, within 14 days.

items.q: How much space do we need?
items.a: Just a little space, ideally near a window. We bring the lights, backdrops, props and outfits for baby.
We bring outfits and wraps for baby. For family photos, soft solid colors look beautiful: cream, beige, sage or light blue. Skip big logos and busy patterns.

items.q: Can siblings and pets be in the photos?
items.a: Siblings and parents join with Our Family Story. Little Moments and Our Little Story are baby only. Want a pet in the photos? Tell us in your booking notes and we'll plan for it.

items.q: Which areas do you cover? Is there a travel fee?
items.a: We're based in Miami Beach and travel anywhere from Miami to Orlando. Homes farther away may have a travel fee, and we'll always confirm it with you before your session.
items.aFee: We're based in Miami Beach and come to homes up to {max} miles away. The first {free} miles are free; after that it's {perMile} a mile, and you'll see the exact travel fee as soon as you type your ZIP code.

items.q: When do we get the photos, and how do we pay?
items.a: Within 24 hours of your session, you'll get a private gallery to choose your favorites (as many as your bundle includes). We edit your picks and deliver them within 72 hours. Nothing is due today: you pay after your session by card, with a secure link we email you.
items.aDeposit: Within 24 hours of your session, you'll get a private gallery to choose your favorites (as many as your bundle includes). We edit your picks and deliver them within 72 hours. When you book, a {deposit} deposit holds your date and counts toward your total. The rest is paid after your session, by card, with a secure link we email you.
items.aDepositFrom: Within 24 hours of your session, you'll get a private gallery to choose your favorites (as many as your bundle includes). We edit your picks and deliver them within 72 hours. When you book, a deposit (from {deposit}, depending on your bundle) holds your date and counts toward your total. The rest is paid after your session, by card, with a secure link we email you.

items: Warm the room you'd like photos in, so baby stays sleepy and comfy.
Pick the room with your biggest window. Just a little space is all we need.
Feed baby just before we arrive. A full tummy means a sleepy baby, and we'll pause for more feeds anytime.
Parents: wear soft, solid colors (no logos or busy patterns) if you'll be in the photos.
Skip perfume and scented lotion on the day.
Want a pet in the photos? Reply to this email and we'll plan for it.
